_說明: 首頁四種語言的文字。build.py 讀這份產生 <語言>/index.html。圖和影片放 img/home/，檔名開頭是語言資料夾名，各語言用自己語言的畫面。auto 只有繁中、簡中、英文有；budget 只有日文有。

zh-Hant.name: 棉棉兔記帳
zh-Hant.title: 棉棉兔記帳｜住著羊毛氈兔兔的記帳 App
zh-Hant.description: 刷完卡，帳就填好了，看過再記。兔子住的房間有白天和夜晚，預算是紙膠帶，收支是印章。兩個人記同一本，每一類分開設預算。

home.p: 看一眼，按一下記進帳本

auto.p: 金額、店名、分類、時間，都先寫在卡片上等你看。
auto.alt: 刷卡通知變成一張填好的待確認卡片，按記帳後排進帳本
points: 刷一次卡跳兩則通知，只變成一張
銀行和付款 App 報同一筆錢，會疊成一張。疊錯了，按「拆開」變回兩張。
右滑，貼綠膠帶打勾。左滑，貼粉膠帶打叉。
姓名、卡號先換成紫色標籤，送出去的內容你看得到。
auto.tip: 你改過一次，下次同樣的通知就照你的寫。

room.p: 白天曬太陽，晚上點蠟燭。翻到資產，鏡頭會走到寶箱前面。

detail.h: 預算是紙膠帶，收支是印章
caps: 花掉多少，膠帶就短多少。
標題畫螢光筆，預算卡用膠帶貼在紙上。

couple.p: 每一筆看得到是誰記的，情侶方案一個人付，兩個人用。

bye: 帳存在自己的手機和雲端。

zh-Hant.heroAlt: 棉棉兔在窗邊的小房間

en.name: Howausa: Bunny Budget
en.title: Howausa: Bunny Budget — a budget app with a felt bunny
en.description: Pay by card and the entry is already filled in. Check it, then save. A felt bunny lives in the room, by day and by candlelight. Share one ledger and set a budget for each category.

home.h1: Pay by card. The entry’s already filled in.
home.p: Take a look, then one tap puts it in your ledger.

auto.h: An alert comes in as a finished card
auto.p: Amount, shop, category and time are written on it, waiting for you to look.
auto.alt: A card alert turns into a filled-in card

demo.masked: Hi Name, your card Card no. was charged $7.50 at Lunch Counter, 12:30.
demo.sent: Only the masked text above is sent

points: Two alerts for one purchase, one card
When your bank and your payment app report the same charge, they stack into one. Stacked wrong? Tap “Split” and you get both back.
Nothing is saved until you look
Swipe right for a green tape check. Swipe left for a pink tape cross.
Before it asks AI, it covers your details
Your name and card number become purple tags, and you can see what was sent.
auto.tip: Fix it once, and the next alert like it is written your way.

room.h: The bunny lives by the window
room.p: Sunlight in the day, a candle at night. Open Assets and the camera walks over to the treasure chest.

detail.h: Budgets are washi tape. Totals are stamps.
caps: Spend some, and the tape gets shorter.
Highlighter on the title, a budget card taped to the page.
Your net worth, on a paper tag.

couple.p: You can see who added each entry.

bye: Your ledger carries over to a new phone.
Kept on your own phone and cloud.

en.heroAlt: Cotton the bunny in a cozy room by the window

android.title: Android beta | Howausa
android.desc: Install the Howausa beta on your Android phone in three steps.
android.sub: Howausa for Android is in closed testing. Three steps and you're in.
steps: Join the tester group
Open the group page with the Google account on your phone and tap “Join group”.
Join group
Become a tester
Open the testing page and tap “Become a tester”.
Become a tester
No button yet? Google is still processing. Wait 5–15 minutes and refresh.
Download from Google Play
On the same page tap “Download it on Google Play”, or use the button below.
Open Google Play
No “Install” yet? Wait 5–15 minutes and open it again.
tips: Use the same Google account for all three steps — the one signed in to the Play Store on your phone.
If a page shows up blank, open it in Chrome and check the account in the top-right corner.
Google Drive sync in the beta is still rolling out, so some accounts can't sign in yet. Everything else works.
